summary: Two registered transfer agents under common ownership, one traditional book-entry agent serving small issuers and one blockchain-based agent, support the proposal's technology-neutral approach, including blockchain master securityholder files, electronic recordkeeping, six-year retention, 15-day record delivery on termination, and the compliance and restrictive-legend rules. They ask the Commission to bar withholding records over fee disputes and to preserve a departing agent's records of its own performance. They also propose refinements on exclusive control of ledger-based files, Rule 17ad-31 mechanics, cybersecurity reporting, form confidentiality and automated (agentic) operation, phased 12- to 18-month compliance dates with longer transition for formerly exempt small agents, and three citation corrections. This is the commenter's position, not an SEC or TitleChain Foundation conclusion.
